name: OneRing Finance
fix_description: The function (0x5b1dac60) uses LP token spot price to determine OShare value. Attacker borrowed $80M USDC via flashloan to inflate LP token price, then extracted OShare at inflated valuation. Fix: use TWAP or time-weighted LP pricing, or add a price deviation check that reverts when LP price moves too much in a single block.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-flash-loan exploit with only a few steps: borrow USDC, deposit into the vulnerable vault, immediately withdraw inflated value, and repay. The PoC is under 50 lines and relies on straightforward vault share/accounting abuse rather than deep multi-protocol or highly protocol-specific reasoning.
